title: Alchemy Delivery Boys — Continuous Causal Village

identity.intent: Keep brewing, both route counterfactuals, the carried potion, and Mira's reaction visible as one warm peculiar village rather than a dashboard or panel sequence.

principles.statement: Player, bottle, route, and recipient remain in one continuous fixed-camera place.
principles.rationale: The delivery reads as an embodied chain rather than automatic travel.

principles.statement: Physical bottle, route response, and Mira pose begin before explanatory interface copy.
principles.rationale: Consequences stay attributable to world actions.

principles.statement: Raster, effects, anchors, UI, and camera resolve on the 480x270 grid.
principles.rationale: One density protects silhouette and material coherence at integer 3x.

principles.statement: Warmth and soothing always pair angular sun and rounded leaf shapes with words or quantities.
principles.rationale: Hue reinforces state but never carries it alone.

principles.statement: Use bounded interaction and consequence beats plus quiet offset ambient motion.
principles.rationale: The scene feels inhabited without unrelated looping noise.

typography.rule: Short place identity may use the 10 px pixel treatment; sustained reading remains 11-12 px humanist sans.

layout.rule: Status owns quiet upper corners; feedback owns a temporary lower strip; action cues remain at their world anchor.

motion.rule: Every non-ambient beat is bound to a real gameplay event and interruption leaves authoritative state visible.

patterns.intent: Keep request or carried state readable without dashboard ownership.
rules: Use one-pixel clipped corners and two-pixel shadow.
Pair potion values with icons and words.

patterns.intent: Make one context verb belong to a nearby world object.
Show which world event changed or preserved potion state.
rules: Feedback stays two lines or fewer.

patterns.intent: Let Mira care visibly about what arrived.
rules: Activate next choice after reaction settles.

references.role: Approved whole-screen route-pending target; never loaded by runtime
references.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: complete gameplay-screen target, proposed design target only, not runtime production art
Primary request: Create a shippable-looking 16:9 pixel-art gameplay screen for ‘Alchemy Delivery Boys’ in the route-pending state. The young courier has just bottled a potion with 1 warmth and 2 soothing and stands at a physical fork, deciding by direct movement between an exposed wind crossing and a sheltered awning lane before delivering to Mira. Preserve the causal layout facts from the reference graybox but completely replace its programmer panels and labels with an authored inhabited village.
Input images: Image 1 and Image 2 are graybox layout-and-state references only; do not copy their art, rectangles, prototype banner, or typography.
Scene/backdrop: One continuous compact peculiar village at a fixed high 3/4 top-down shipping camera. Brew yard and partner on the left, cauldron and ingredient planters nearby; fork and both traversable routes through the center; Mira waiting at her cottage doorway on the right. Exposed upper route is visibly wind-prone with a turning vane, loose pennants, and pale gust streamers. Sheltered lower route runs under timber awnings and mossy cloth. Both routes are simultaneously visible, plausibly walkable, and reconnect before Mira.
Subject: One readable 24x32-style courier silhouette with satchel and visibly carried bottle; partner near brew yard; Mira at destination. Bottle contents use an angular amber sun mark for warmth and rounded mint leaf marks for soothing, not color alone.
Style/medium: authored production-quality pixel art, crisp nearest-neighbor pixel clusters, 16x16 tile rhythm, warm peculiar storybook village, strong silhouettes, no painterly blur, no mixed pixel density.
Composition/framing: Exact 16:9 whole viewport. World fills the canvas and is dominant. Keep a clear movement corridor around the courier and both route thresholds. Place a compact parchment request slip over quiet upper-left roof/sky scenery and a compact cork-tag carried-potion badge over quiet upper-right roof/sky scenery. A tiny world-anchored action glyph may appear near the courier; no dashboard frame.
Lighting/mood: late golden afternoon, welcoming but windswept, lived-in clutter kept away from paths.
Color palette: ink #1B1A24, deep slate #2A3341, plum shadow #44354E, wood #6B4638, clay #A85D43, ember #E66A3C, warmth #F3B94E, paper #F4E1B5, moss dark #345B43, moss #69A35C, soothing #83C9A0, roof blue #4D6D7A, wind #B7DCE1, alchemy violet #8467A8, specular #FFF3CE.
Text (verbatim): parchment slip ‘MIRA NEEDS 2 WARMTH + 1 SOOTHING’; cork tag ‘BOTTLED 1 WARMTH + 2 SOOTHING’; short sign labels only ‘GUST’ and ‘SHELTER’.
Typography: short place labels use expressive pixel display type; request and carried-state copy use a calm readable humanist sans. All copy is legible, correctly spelled, and high contrast.
Constraints: direct movement chooses the route; no route-choice buttons or cards; no UI covers any character, path, route threshold, hazard tell, destination, bottle, or prompt; no accidental overlap; no extra meters; no extra characters; no logos; no watermark. This is a complete gameplay viewport, not a mood board or concept-art vignette.
Avoid: generic purple cards, arbitrary rounded panels, nested borders, inventory grids, cinematic close-up, side-scrolling composition, isometric cutaway diorama, decorative frame, painterly anti-aliasing, text gibberish, prototype graybox labels.

metadata.hypothesis: A direct authored native-pixel set plus target-measured code-native UI preserves the continuous causal village more faithfully than cutout extraction from baked whole-screen targets.
metadata.evidenceBoundary: Deterministic scenarios and real-engine captures establish contract completion and production integration, not human evidence of fun.
